text.description_html:
Acorn RH2BQ, Rough Iron H-Style Offset Cabinet Hinge

The 3 Inch Offset Cabinet Hinge Pair features a 3/8 inch offset for where the door face sits 3/8" out from the door frame. It is easy to install with just a few screws. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron. It has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Also Available:
Flush 3 Inch Cabinet Hinge
3 Inch H-L Hinge

Features and Specifications of the Rough Iron 3" H-Style Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 3"
  • Width: 1-7/16"
  • Offset: 3/8"
  • Early American Styling

Priced and sold as a pair (2-hinges)
